caption_L1: Here a is a area plot labeled Number of persons covered by life insurance on the domestic market in Italy from 2004 to 2017 , by type of contract (in millions). On the y-axis, Group life insurance is plotted along a linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 14. The x-axis shows Year.
caption_L2L3: 2004 shows the lowest amount of people in Italy with life insurance at around 6 million. This increases as the Years go on and reach dramatic increase in years 2008-2010 to 14 million people. By 2011 this has dipped to 10 million people and is slowly decreasing through years 2011-2016.
